zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增无缝播放：自动预载下一首，切歌不再有停顿
• 播放倍速改为固定档位（0.25–5×），其中 0.5–2× 保持音调不变
• 新增动态压限（软拐点压缩与峰值限幅），默认关闭
• 主窗口支持自定义图片背景与模糊强度
• 详情页与系统媒体控制显示同一张高分辨率封面；封面缓存失败时回退原图，不再丢失封面
• 「关于」页统一缓存设置：显示缓存总大小，WebDAV 播放缓存并入同一卡片
• 修复小窗口下旋转网格背景模糊过度
• 修复 OpenList 网盘歌曲误报「远程文件已变化」及保存来源卡顿
en:
Release Notes
• Added gapless playback: the next track is preloaded and starts without a pause
• Playback speed now uses fixed steps (0.25–5×), pitch-preserving between 0.5–2×
• Added dynamics compression (soft-knee compressor with peak limiter), off by default
• Custom image background with adjustable blur for the main window
• The detail page and System Media Controls now share the same high-resolution cover; falls back to the original image when cover caching fails
• The About page unifies cache settings: total cache size is shown and WebDAV playback cache moves into the same card
• Fixed excessive blur of the rotating mesh background in small windows
• Fixed OpenList cloud songs falsely reporting "remote file changed" and lag when saving sources
